evaluate_masks_segmentation: evaluate segmentation masks on a COCO JSON dataset and return COCOeval results with AP metrics
evaluate_boxes_detection: evaluate bounding box detections on a COCO JSON dataset and return COCOeval results with AP metrics
evaluate_box_proposals_recall: evaluate detection proposal recall metrics for region proposals against ground truth boxes with configurable IoU thresholds
evaluate_keypoints_pose: evaluate keypoint pose estimation results on a COCO JSON dataset and return COCOeval results with AP metrics
log_detection_eval_metrics: log mean and per-category average precision metrics from a COCOeval object across IoU thresholds 0.5 to 0.95
